report.summary: Advisory review of the display-only risk presentation change. The core intent (verbatim saved report, conservative image evidence gap labeling, unchanged participant reviews) appears implemented, but I found one reproducible rendering/interaction defect in the assessment UI and one labeling precision concern in the gap classifier. No acceptance-authority or runtime scope creep was introduced.

findings.title: Controlled open prop freezes expand/collapse state to initial value
findings.evidence: Line 89 sets <details ... open={initiallyExpanded}> where initiallyExpanded is a one-time useState(!readOnly). React controls the open attribute; user toggling the native <details> summary changes DOM but React reasserts open on re-render, so the panel cannot be collapsed/expanded reliably after any state change (e.g., busy toggling at line 66-68, or review saves bumping riskReviews).
findings.reproduction: Render DeliveryAssessment with readOnly=false and a saved report. Click the <summary> to collapse it. Trigger a parent re-render (e.g., set busy=true then false, or save a risk review updating riskReviews). The panel reopens because open={initiallyExpanded=true} is reasserted; likewise a readOnly report cannot be opened because open stays false.
findings.suggestion: Use uncontrolled open via defaultOpen={initiallyExpanded} (or omit open), and rely on the existing useEffect/ref to force-open on busy; do not bind a live controlled open prop.

findings.title: Image evidence gap requires all four conjunctive signals, so genuine unseen-image risks may show generic label
findings.evidence: imageEvidenceGap = hasRasterExclusion && quotesImage && aboutImageSubject && asksForObservation. A risk whose citation excerpt is not exactly an (e.g., icon via CSS background, or alt text quoted from a
findings.reproduction: Construct a risk with explanation 'The hero image may not show the required blue bowl', suggestion 'Confirm the image pixels show the bowl', citations citing a CSS background-image rule rather than an tag, coverage.omittedFiles=['poster.png']. assessmentRiskPresentation returns kind 'unverified_source_indication' and title equal to risk.title, surfacing the unverified visual-mismatch phrasing the change intended to neutralize.
findings.suggestion: Relax the quotesImage gate so an explicit raster exclusion plus image-subject plus observation request is sufficient, or additionally match CSS background/raster references so the conservative gap label applies.

limitations: No tools available; findings are based on static reading of the four supplied files only.
Assessment of whether provider-side model wording actually triggers the regexes (line 45-47 of assessment-display.ts) relies on the supplied counterexample test shapes, not on live model output.
No pixel model, runtime execution, or acceptance authority is implied; the DeliveryAssessment behavior on events not shown (e.g., onSaveRiskReview) was inferred from call sites.
